name: Hexyl acetate
description: Hexyl acetate (CAS 142-92-7 ), also identified by FEMA 2565 , is a synthetic ester used commercially as a flavoring agent and fragrance ingredient. It delivers a characteristic fresh, fruity note that makes it a target compound for flavor houses. This aroma chemical is predominantly used to replicate apple and pear notes in various industrial applications. In food and beverage manufacturing, it is used to build or reinforce fruit flavor profiles in confectionery and baked goods. It is also a staple in beverages and chewing gum formulations. Fragrance formulators incorporate it into fine fragrances, body care products, and household products where a light, fresh-fruity topnote is required for the consumer experience. In personal care, it functions as a skin-conditioning emollient and carrier in formulations such as serums and leave-on treatments. Its low viscosity supports even distribution across the skin surface during application. The compound also appears in functional flavor systems designed for alcoholic beverages and dairy applications. It is supplied as a clear, mobile liquid in standard packaging ranging from drums to ISO containers depending on volume. It is available in food-grade and fragrance-grade specifications, with FEMA 2565 status supporting its use in flavoring applications in regulated markets. Buyers should confirm purity levels and compliance documentation for their needs. Documentation such as natural vs. synthetic declarations should be reviewed based on end-product labeling requirements.
